def factor_overnight_intraday_volregime_combo(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    short_signal = intraday_ret.rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean() + (-overnight_ret).rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean()
    long_signal = intraday_ret.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean() + (-overnight_ret).rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    signal = np.where(vol_ratio > 1.0, short_signal, long_signal)
    df_copy["factor_overnight_intraday_volregime_combo"] = signal
    return df_copy["factor_overnight_intraday_volregime_combo"]
description: Crossover between intraday/overnight combo (parent 1) and volume awareness (parent 2). Primary mechanism: intraday momentum plus overnight reversal, aggregated via rolling means. Lightweight modifier: dynamic window length controlled by volume ratio (relative to 20-day MA), switching between short (5-day) and long (20-day) windows based on current volume activity. This preserves parent 1's additive price pattern intuition while incorporating parent 2's volume-regime concept to adapt signal responsiveness, targeting improved ICIR and robustness across varying market conditions.
